description: Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by publisher not stated on the toolkit page. This is an integrated database of daily climate summaries from land surface stations across the globe. GHCNd is made up of daily climate records from numerous sources that have been integrated and subjected to a common suite of quality assurance reviews. GHCNd contains records from more than 100,000 stations in 180 countries and territories. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
